content.text: All responsive language is in §§ 21.1–21.4, with no conflicting limitations elsewhere (18.2 and 19.5 expressly preserve liability, warranties and indemnities).

input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The clause meets the preferred position in full. § 21.1 imposes an expressly mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. § 21.2 excludes indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive and consequential damages mutually ("neither Party"), and helpfully confirms that Customer Data restoration, replacement services, notice and incident-response costs are direct damages. § 21.3 places outside the cap each Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection or security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's payment obligation is not damages subject to the Section. "Fees" (§ 1.5) is a substantive recurring subscription/professional services/usage fee base, so the cap is not illusory; § 21.4 preserves each cap independently and prevents the exclusions from swallowing unlawfully limited liability. Two immaterial points noted only for the record: Fees exclude a one-time implementation charge unless an Order Form says otherwise, and the payment carve-out is confined to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" (a narrowing in our favour). No redline required.
